notes: Pulled from Visit Seattle's city-run event calendar. Focuses on cultural, arts, music, and public city events. All event times are in ISO 8601 UTC format.

how_to_access.general: Visit the official Seattle tourism event calendar for details. Penny provides relevant highlights.

events.name: Seattle Winter Lights Festival
events.description: A walk-through light installation and winter art experience celebrating the season downtown. Primarily an outdoor, walking event.

events.name: Holiday Market at Westlake Park
events.description: Local artisans, music, and food celebrating Seattle's creative scene and winter festivities. Held outdoors in the plaza.

events.name: New Year's Eve Fireworks at the Space Needle
events.description: Ring in the New Year with a spectacular fireworks display and live music in Seattle's iconic landmark. Large outdoor gathering.
